summary: Partition deed dated 04.12.1989 upheld; Will dated 06.04.1990 challenged; concurrent findings on ownership of first-schedule properties as self-acquired; legitimacy of second wife and children addressed; defendants' entitlement to 1/7th share each; Will held invalid due to suspicious circumstances; Section 63 Succession Act and Section 68 Evidence Act compliance disputed; execution and attestation examined; Trial Court and High Court findings sustained; no interference warranted.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; judgment and decree of Trial Court and High Court affirmed.
